style.styleTitle: Scottish Everlastings Ltd Christmas Eucalyptus & Bauble Garland
style.toneOfVoice: Drape your space in festive magic with this 183cm artificial eucalyptus & bauble garland—a stunning blend of soft, silvery eucalyptus leaves and gleaming festive baubles. This elegant garland brings a fresh, modern twist to traditional Christmas décor, combining natural beauty with a touch of shimmer. Perfect for dressing up mantels, stair rails, door frames, or festive tablescapes, it adds instant charm and a feeling of cosy celebration to any setting. Whether your holiday aesthetic is rustic chic, contemporary glam, or timeless elegance, this garland is your go-to piece for effortless seasonal beauty.  Garland Length: L183cm. Bring indoors during adverse weather conditions.
